def test_comma_in_payee_is_quoted_for_any_currency():
    import csv, io

    for currency in ("USD", "EUR"):
        text = export_statement(
            [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, 'say "hi"', currency)]
